headline: 《Industry》Real Estate-Securities Combined Income Tax Surges in August; Northern, Northern-Central, and Central Taiwan All Hit Record Highs for the Period - Finance
summary: Taiwan's real estate-securities combined income tax from January to August totalled about NT$34.12 billion, down 1.1% year on year. August collections hit record highs for the period in northern, north-central and central Taiwan.
why: The real estate-securities combined income tax is a levy on property and securities transactions, so its collections signal activity in Taiwan's property and share markets. Investors watch it as a gauge of domestic transaction volumes.
